selected_evidence.requirement: Require passwords to contain at least 12 literal characters
selected_evidence.summary: Shows minlen=12 with all length credits disabled; an 11-character four-class candidate is rejected before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Require at least three character classes
selected_evidence.summary: Shows minclass=3; a 12-character two-class candidate is rejected and a 12-character three-class candidate is accepted before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy OS release and kernel and use compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Confirms RHEL 7.9, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64, and use of the already-installed RHEL 7 pam_pwquality/libpwquality stack; release and kernel remain unchanged.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 16506e97-59db-479a-a849-fb94bde0b214, and recovered system health with persistent policy and successful behavioral checks.
